-- Test fixture setup (in-memory SQLite)
CREATE TABLE users (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    username TEXT NOT NULL,
    role TEXT NOT NULL,
    password_hash TEXT NOT NULL
);

INSERT INTO users (username, role, password_hash) VALUES
    ('admin', 'admin', 'hash_admin'),
    ('alice', 'user', 'hash_alice'),
    ('bob', 'user', 'hash_bob');

-- =============================================================
-- TEST CASE 1: TAUTOLOGY ATTACK
-- Input: ' OR 1=1 --
-- Intended by attacker: SELECT * FROM users WHERE username = '' OR 1=1 --' AND ...
-- =============================================================
-- Parameterized query (safe):
SELECT * FROM users WHERE username = ? AND role = 'user';
-- With parameter: ' OR 1=1 --
-- Result: no rows (because parameter is treated as literal data)

-- =============================================================
-- TEST CASE 2: UNION ATTACK
-- Input: ' UNION SELECT password_hash, 'x', 'y' FROM users --
-- Intended by attacker: SELECT * FROM users WHERE username = '' UNION SELECT ...
-- =============================================================
-- Parameterized query (safe):
SELECT * FROM users WHERE username = ? AND role = 'user';
-- With parameter: ' UNION SELECT password_hash, 'x', 'y' FROM users --
-- Result: no rows (parameter is literal, no UNION occurs)

-- =============================================================
-- TEST CASE 3: COMMENT TRUNCATION ATTACK
-- Input: ' OR 1=1; DROP TABLE users; --
-- Intended by attacker: SELECT * FROM users WHERE username = '' OR 1=1; DROP TABLE users; --' AND ...
-- =============================================================
-- Parameterized query (safe):
SELECT * FROM users WHERE username = ? AND role = 'user';
-- With parameter: ' OR 1=1; DROP TABLE users; --
-- Result: no rows, table still exists (parameter is literal data)
